title: A Guide To The Good Life

questions.q: What are the two highest values for a Stoic?
questions.why: Lesson 1 says virtue and tranquility are the central themes.

a: Adapting to what you have and always wanting more
questions.why: Lesson 2 calls it hedonic adaptation, the vicious cycle of wanting more.

questions.q: What exercise helps you appreciate what you have?
questions.why: Lesson 2 describes imagining losing the things you take for granted.

questions.q: What is the first step toward tranquility in lesson 3?
a: Recognizing when something is outside your control
Making a plan to change it
questions.why: Lesson 3 starts with realizing when something is beyond your control.

questions.q: What should you do with worries about things you can't control?
a: Not distract yourself worrying about them, even briefly
questions.why: The second step is not worrying about it for even a second.
